meta.name_zh: 癌症登記檔短表 SF(2007-2010年)
meta.data_description_zh: 收錄各醫院申報 2007-2010年診斷個案之原始資料。
meta.notes_zh:
1. ※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身
分證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日
期等欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜
出經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
2. 收錄各醫院申報 2007-2010 年診斷個案之原始資料，並未進行院際間相同個案同
一癌症同一組織型態分組之重複個案去除。
3. 癌症登記短表所包含之癌症別，除短表醫院申報的所有癌症外，還包含長表醫院
申報之外其他所有癌別，均以短表申報。
4. 如需分析自 1979年診斷至最新發表年度，且已去除院際重複之年報歸戶資料，請
申請年報歸戶檔。
meta.primary_keys_raw:
1. 身分證字號(ID)經加密處理。
2. 個人歸戶及個人資料對照的鍵值：ID。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health15_癌症登記檔短表SF(2010年以前版本)
meta.data_description_en: Includes original data of cases diagnosed in 2007-2010, reported by each hospital.
meta.notes_en:
1. ※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address were deleted, and fields such as
national ID number, facility code, insured unit code, unified business number, date of birth, date of visit and admission date are
masked. The data may be used only in the independent work area set up by this Ministry, and only statistical results
that pass review may be taken out, to ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify any specific individual.
2. Contains the raw data reported by hospitals for cases diagnosed in 2007-2010; duplicate cases (the
same case with the same cancer and the same histology group across hospitals) have not been removed.
3. The cancers covered by the cancer registry short form (short form) include all cancers reported by short-form hospitals as
well as all other cancer types outside those reported by long-form hospitals, all of which are reported on the short form.
4. To analyze data from diagnosis year 1979 to the latest published year with
inter-hospital duplicates removed (annual-report linked data), please apply for the annual-report linked file.
meta.primary_keys_en:
1. Personal ID number (ID) is encrypted.
2. Key for individual linkage and personal-data matching: ID.

meta.notes_en:

national ID number, facility code, insured unit code, unified business number, date of birth, date of visit and admission date are
masked. The data may be used only in the independent work area set up by this Ministry, and only statistical results
that pass review may be taken out, to ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify any specific individual.
2. All cancer cases diagnosed on or after January 1, 2018 are reported according to the ROC year 107 (2018) edition of the Cancer Registry Abstracting Manual.
3. Contains the raw data reported by hospitals; duplicate cases (the same case with
the same cancer and the same histology group across hospitals) have not been removed.
4. The cancers covered by the cancer registry short form (ROC year 107 (2018) edition) include all cancers reported by short-form hospitals
as well as all other cancer types outside those reported by long-form hospitals, all of which are reported on the short form.
5. For cases with case classification 0 or 3, field serial numbers 7.1-7.5 need not be reported; fill with 9.
6. To analyze data from diagnosis year 1979 to the latest published year with
inter-hospital duplicates removed (annual-report linked data), please apply for the annual-report linked file.
meta.primary_keys_en:
1. Personal ID number (ID) is encrypted.
2. Key for individual linkage and personal-data matching: ID.
